purpose: Design the minimum prospective runtime remediation needed to make Round-022 observation sources implementable and testable without claiming current source readiness.

S01.reason: evaluateSignalQuality exists but has no non-test production call site, advisory identity, or informationAsOf.

S02.reason: Regime helpers and DTOs are caller-supplied and lack a producer-owned PIT source.

S03.reason: Risk helpers exist but no authoritative prospective producer and PIT identity are persisted.

S04.reason: historical-review-protocol.ts is design-only and signal-review is settlement state, not prospective historical metadata.

S05.reason: The builder is caller-supplied with no non-test production invocation or durable input linkage.

S06.reason: Email/dashboard render call sites exist, but rendering is not identity-linked evidence.

S07.reason: Required cross-source causal validation is not an authoritative runtime evidence boundary.

S08.reason: No server-side human-review start event exists.

S09.reason: No server-side human-review submit event exists.

S10.reason: No shared append-only evidence writer validates identity, hashes, PIT, and causality for all sources.

P01.limitation: P01 is not an R22 snapshot and cannot make S01-S06 ready.

P02.limitation: No non-test call site or persistence; P02 cannot substitute for upstream evidence.

findings: P01 route and advisory store are real service-side call sites.
S01-S03 helpers are not called by the advisory scan in the accepted source.
S04 has no runtime producer; signal-review is a settlement/review ledger and is not a Historical Review substitute.
S05 wrapper and S06 renderers exist, but neither creates R22 evidence with identity/PIT provenance.
O05 notification evidence is already implemented as a best-effort sidecar and is not redesigned here.
Existing migrations contain advisory delivery and settlement-review tables, not the future observation evidence writer designed here.
